title: 心肺复苏与AED
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/159_心肺复苏与AED.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/159_心肺复苏与AED/src.py

points.S3: 胸外按压：位置深度频率

shots.scene: 欣欣跪在训练模型旁，双手交叠
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot kneels beside a training manikin with its paws stacked on the manikin's chest, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第14章第五课：心肺复苏与AED。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁是心形和闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot points to a heart icon and a small lightning bolt icon floating beside it.
shots.narration: 学会这两样，关键时刻能救命。

shots.scene: 走廊里，老周突然倒地
shots.prompt_en: In a university building corridor, the older man suddenly collapses to the floor beside a lab door.
shots.narration: 老周在走廊里突然倒下了。

shots.scene: 阿杰愣在原地，不知所措
shots.prompt_en: The young male student freezes in shock, hands raised, looking around with question marks.
shots.narration: 阿杰吓呆了，不知道该怎么办。

shots.scene: 小研跑过来，指向墙上的AED
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student runs over and points to an AED cabinet on the corridor wall.
shots.narration: 小研跑来：快打120，拿AED！

shots.scene: 小研跪下准备施救
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student kneels beside the older man, ready to help.
shots.narration: 抢救，就从这几分钟开始。

shots.scene: 心脏图标停跳，时钟走动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heart icon with a flat line and a clock icon with its hand moving fast. No text.
shots.narration: 心脏骤停，几分钟内就会致命。

shots.scene: 大脑图标缺氧变暗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a brain icon slowly dimming as an oxygen icon fades away. No text.
shots.narration: 大脑缺氧几分钟，就会严重损伤。

shots.scene: 四个环节连成链条：呼救、按压、除颤、医院
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chain of four linked icons, a phone, hands pressing a chest, a lightning bolt pad and an ambulance. No text.
shots.narration: 早呼救、早按压、早除颤、早送医。

shots.scene: AED放出电击，心跳恢复
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an AED with two pads and a lightning bolt, a heart icon returning to a normal rhythm line. No text.
shots.narration: 及时用AED除颤，能提高救活机会。

shots.scene: 等救护车时不做任何事，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: people standing around a collapsed person just waiting for an ambulance, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 光等救护车，会错过最佳时机。

shots.scene: 倒地者旁有漏电的设备和积水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lying near a sparking power cord and a puddle of water, a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 施救前，先看现场安不安全。

shots.scene: 徒手去拉触电者，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a bare hand grabbing a person stuck to a sparking cable, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 有人触电，不能直接用手去拉。

shots.scene: 拉下电闸，切断电源
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pulling down a main switch on an electrical panel, the sparks stopping. No text.
shots.narration: 先切断电源，再靠近施救。

shots.scene: 有火有毒气，先撤到安全处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: helpers moving a person away from a smoking bench to a safe corridor. No text.
shots.narration: 现场有火、有毒气，先转移到安全处。

shots.scene: 轻拍双肩，大声呼唤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper kneeling beside a lying person, tapping both shoulders and calling loudly. No text.
shots.narration: 轻拍双肩，大声呼唤：你怎么了？

shots.scene: 【实拍】施救者侧头看训练模型胸部起伏
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a trainer kneels beside a training manikin, face turned toward its chest, watching for chest movement.
shots.narration: 没反应，马上看胸口有没有起伏。

shots.scene: 时钟图标，十秒以内
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper watching a chest with a small stopwatch icon showing a short time. No text.
shots.narration: 观察不超过10秒，别耽误时间。

shots.scene: 偶尔叹气样呼吸，打问号
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a lying person with an occasional weak gasp icon, a question mark turning into a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 只有叹气样喘息，不算正常呼吸。

shots.scene: 无反应、无正常呼吸，立即开始
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unresponsive person, a no breathing icon and an arrow to hands pressing the chest. No text.
shots.narration: 没反应、没正常呼吸，马上心肺复苏。

shots.scene: 大声喊人帮忙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the helper shouting for help with sound waves, two people running over. No text.
shots.narration: 大声呼救，叫周围的人来帮忙。

shots.scene: 指定一人打120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the helper pointing at one person who dials a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 指定一个人：你，打120！

shots.scene: 指定另一人取AED
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the helper pointing at another person who runs to an AED cabinet on the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 再指定一个人：你，去拿AED！

shots.scene: 电话里说清地点和情况
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person on the phone, a building icon and a lying person icon beside the phone. No text.
shots.narration: 说清楼号房间，有人倒地无呼吸。

shots.scene: 通知负责人和学院
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a phone with arrows to a supervisor icon and a school building icon. No text.
shots.narration: 同时报告实验室负责人和学院。

shots.scene: 日常就记住AED放在哪
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a floor plan with an AED cabinet icon marked by a star near the stairs. No text.
shots.narration: 平时就要记住，楼里AED在哪。

shots.section_title: 胸外按压：位置深度频率
shots.scene: 让人仰卧在硬地面上
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lying on the back on a hard floor, a soft mattress crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 让他仰卧在坚硬平整的地面上。
overlay: 胸外按压：位置深度频率

shots.section_title: 胸外按压：位置深度频率
shots.scene: 【实拍】掌根放在训练模型胸部正中
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a trainer places the heel of one hand on the center of a training manikin's chest, on the lower half of the breastbone.
shots.narration: 按压位置：胸部正中，胸骨下半部。

shots.section_title: 胸外按压：位置深度频率
shots.scene: 两手掌根重叠，手指翘起
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two hands stacked with fingers interlaced and lifted, only the heel of the hand touching the chest. No text.
shots.narration: 双手掌根重叠，手指不要贴胸。

shots.section_title: 胸外按压：位置深度频率
shots.scene: 【实拍】手臂伸直，垂直向下用力按压
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a trainer kneels with straight arms and shoulders directly above a training manikin, pressing straight down.
shots.narration: 手臂伸直，用上身力量垂直下压。

shots.section_title: 胸外按压：位置深度频率
shots.scene: 深度标尺：五到六厘米
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a side view of a chest being pressed down with a small depth gauge beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 成人按压深度五到六厘米。

shots.section_title: 胸外按压：位置深度频率
shots.scene: 节拍器图标：每分钟一百到一百二十次
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a metronome icon and a fast heartbeat rhythm next to pressing hands. No text.
shots.narration: 频率每分钟一百到一百二十次。

shots.section_title: 胸外按压：位置深度频率
shots.scene: 每次放松，胸廓完全回弹
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a chest rising back fully between presses, the hands staying in place. No text.
shots.narration: 每次放松，让胸廓完全回弹。

shots.section_title: 胸外按压：位置深度频率
shots.scene: 按压不停，尽量少中断
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a continuous rhythm line with only very short pauses. No text.
shots.narration: 尽量不中断，边按边数数。

shots.scene: 侧头查看口中有无异物
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper turning a lying person's head slightly to check the mouth for anything blocking it. No text.
shots.narration: 口中有异物，先清除。

shots.scene: 【实拍】仰头提颏，打开训练模型气道
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a trainer places one hand on a training manikin's forehead and lifts the chin with two fingers of the other hand.
shots.narration: 一手压额头，一手抬下巴，打开气道。

shots.scene: 捏住鼻子，口对口吹气，胸廓起伏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper pinching the nose and giving a breath through a face shield, the chest rising. No text.
shots.narration: 捏住鼻子吹气，看到胸廓抬起。

shots.scene: 三十次按压加两次吹气，循环
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a loop of thirty small pressing hand icons followed by two breath icons. No text.
shots.narration: 按压30次，吹气2次，循环进行。

shots.scene: 用呼吸面罩
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pocket face shield placed over a training manikin's mouth. No text.
shots.narration: 有呼吸面罩，就用面罩隔开。

shots.scene: 不会吹气也不停，只按压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper doing continuous chest compressions only, a breath icon greyed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不会或不愿吹气，就持续按压。

shots.scene: AED送到，打开盖子
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person arriving with an AED case and placing it beside the lying person, opening the lid. No text.
shots.narration: AED一到，马上打开电源。

shots.scene: AED发出语音提示
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an AED with a speaker icon giving voice prompts and blinking lights. No text.
shots.narration: 它会用语音一步一步告诉你。

shots.scene: 【实拍】把电极片贴在训练模型裸露胸部
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a trainer peels two pads from an AED trainer and sticks one below the right collarbone and one on the left side of a manikin's chest below the armpit.
shots.narration: 露出胸部，照图贴好两片电极片。

shots.scene: 胸部有水先擦干
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a towel wiping a wet chest before attaching pads. No text.
shots.narration: 胸部有水先擦干，贴紧不留缝。

shots.scene: 分析心律时大家都离开
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an AED analyzing with a heart rhythm icon, everyone's hands lifted away from the person. No text.
shots.narration: 分析心律时，任何人不要碰他。

shots.scene: 【实拍】施救者张开手臂示意离开，再按电击键
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a trainer sweeps one arm to signal everyone back, then presses the flashing shock button on an AED trainer.
shots.narration: 提示电击，喊大家离开，再按键。

shots.scene: 电击后立即继续按压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: right after the lightning bolt icon, hands return to pressing the chest. No text.
shots.narration: 电击后，马上接着按压。

shots.scene: AED提示不需电击，继续按压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an AED with a no shock icon and an arrow back to chest compressions. No text.
shots.narration: 不需要电击，也继续按压。

shots.scene: 两人轮换按压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: two helpers kneeling side by side, one taking over chest compressions from the other. No text.
shots.narration: 多人轮流按压，换人要快。

shots.scene: AED电极片一直贴着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: AED pads kept on the chest while compressions continue, the AED still switched on. No text.
shots.narration: 电极片别撕，AED一直开着。

shots.scene: 急救人员到场接手
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: ambulance crew with a stretcher arriving and kneeling to take over. No text.
shots.narration: 坚持到专业急救人员接手。

shots.scene: 伤者恢复呼吸，侧卧观察
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person breathing again and turned onto the side in the recovery position, a helper watching. No text.
shots.narration: 恢复呼吸，侧卧，继续观察。

shots.scene: 向急救人员说明经过
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student tells the ambulance crew what happened, pointing to the AED.
shots.narration: 向急救人员说明时间和经过。

shots.scene: CPR三个字母变成心肺图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a heart and a pair of lungs icon with hands pressing in the middle. No text.
shots.narration: 心肺复苏，在心跳呼吸停止时维持生命。

shots.scene: 学生们在模型上练习
shots.prompt_en: Students practice chest compressions on training manikins in a first aid class led by the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 要参加正规培训，在模型上练熟。

shots.scene: 结业证书图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a blank training certificate with a heart icon and a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 定期复训，手法才不会忘。

shots.scene: 法律保护见义勇为的施救者
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield icon over a helper doing chest compressions, a balance scale icon beside it. No text.
shots.narration: 自愿救助，法律保护施救的人。

shots.scene: 阿杰报名参加培训
shots.prompt_en: The young male student signs a blank sign-up sheet for a first aid class, the female graduate student nodding.
shots.narration: 阿杰说：下次，我也能出手。

shots.scene: 盾牌、眼睛和电话图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield icon, an eye watching a chest and a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 先保安全，判断意识呼吸，呼救。

shots.scene: 按压图标和数字
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands pressing a chest with a metronome icon and a loop icon. No text.
shots.narration: 胸部正中，用力快按，30比2。

shots.scene: AED和急救人员
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an AED with pads next to an ambulance crew arriving. No text.
shots.narration: AED到了就用，坚持到专业人员来。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在洗眼器旁挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside an eyewash station and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：化学灼伤与眼部急救。
